artist.name: Jillian Rossi
artist.short_description: Jillian Rossi: an Afterglow editorial discovery candidate in pop.
artist.biography: Jillian Rossi is an American pop singer-songwriter from Long Island, New York, known for emotionally direct vocal performances and songs drawn from relationship experiences. Her early releases include “So What,” “Fever Dream,” and “Give Me a Reason,” while her catalogue later expanded through the album Never Fully Loved and subsequent singles. Apple Music lists those songs and projects under her recording-artist identity, which must not be confused with another artist of the same name. Her interviews are particularly useful for Afterglow: in a conversation with Backward Noise, she described how “Fever Dream” drew from a difficult relationship; in Flaunt she discussed “Give Me a Reason” in relation to an earlier long-distance situation. Because these are direct explanations, the site can accurately distinguish the artist’s account from its own editorial assessment of the songs. Her catalogue connects naturally to Rachel Grae, Andi, and Jessica Baio for discovery purposes, although those similarities are suggestions made by Afterglow and not a statement of endorsement.
